name: City Council Special Meeting - Closed Session
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council – CLOSED SESSION
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 14, 2023 at 4:00 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Member of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers. For Special Meetings, public
 communications are limited to agenda items. Once public comments are heard, the Closed
 Session will begin, and the meeting will be locked to unauthorized persons.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83689077352
  Webinar ID: 836 8907 7352
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83689077352# OR +16699009128,,83689077352#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 US or +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 205 0468

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 4:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments on Closed Session Items only – may be
submitted electronically prior to the closed session starting. Members of the public may offer
comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed
on Page 1 of this agenda. Live comments will be limited to three minutes. Refer to Page 1 of the Agenda
on how to submit your Public Comments electronically or how to provide Live Public Comments.

CLOSED SESSION:

  1. Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(1))
  Name of Case: Gist v. City of Westlake Village et al. (LASC Case No.
  20VECV01171)

  2. Conference with Real Property Negotiator
  (Government Code Section 54956.8)
  Property: Portion of Lot 14, Tract No. 43744
  City of Westlake Village Negotiator: City Manager Rob de Geus
  Negotiating Party: Agoura and Lindero Associates LLC
  Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment

  3. Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation
  Initiation of Litigation (California Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4)):
  2 potential cases

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, June 8, 2023 at 5:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal business hours
 and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
